info.name: Quix Cloud HTTP APIs Definitions Event Data API

params.name: topicName
params.description: The name of the topic the stream belongs to.

params.name: streamId
params.description: The unique identifier of the stream. Publishing to an id that does not exist creates the stream implicitly.

items.docs: Publishes one or more discrete events to a stream. Each event carries a nanosecond `timestamp`, an `id`, an optional `value`, and optional `tags`.
